split.method: 70th percentile sanction date with whole-date grouping

design.a: Fixed continuous delay and early-stage aging rules
design.b: A plus robust historical peer cost and same-IDA/type historical duplicate evidence
design.labels: No real fraud labels; synthetic labels record explicitly injected evidence only

actual_data.interpretation: Observed queue composition only; the original data has no confirmed fraud labels.

bootstrap.method: Paired stratified nonparametric bootstrap, percentile interval; rerank inside each resample at the same review budget.

synthetic_benchmark.meaning: Recovery of deliberately injected evidence. Untouched records are unlabeled background, not verified negatives. Injected cases per review is not real fraud precision.
